summary: ExchangeRight Income Fund filed an 8-K reporting an amendment and restatement of its credit agreement with Wells Fargo and other lenders. The amended agreement provides a $200 million revolving credit facility and a $400 million delayed draw term loan facility, each maturing in 2029 and 2026 respectively, with the ability to increase total commitments up to $1 billion. This is a routine refinancing and extension of existing credit facilities, not a special situation change.
